div.div: Identity & Auth Flow: Public user → CloudFront/WAF → WordPress plugin proxy (holds server-side APIM subscription key) → App Gateway + WAF (included) → APIM validates & applies AI policies → backend (Managed Identity) → Foundry agent. Backends authenticate to Azure AI Search, Azure OpenAI/Foundry, Storage & Key Vault via Managed Identity over Private Link. APIM authenticates to the model with its managed identity — no model key on the wire. Public users never receive Azure identities and never call Foundry directly.
